notes: Audit #2 Batch 4 «بهینه‌سازی ذخیره و API» (v1.11.71) — the fourth of the 5 approved batches of the v1.11.67 full audit (88/100, 0 Critical, 0 High). (1) L13 — POST /api/testbook returns only {"ok": true} on 200 with the seq in the X-Testbook-Seq header (same L-PERF8 slimming as /api/state in 1.11.61; ~103KB saved per debounced save — no client code ever read the 200 body, only res.ok + the header). The 409 branch still returns the full testbook for the client-side rebase. (2) L14 — server-side no-op short-circuit (save_state_if_changed): when the merged state is byte-identical to the stored state, the write + bump_seq are skipped — the server-side counterpart of the client's lastSentStateBody skip. A second tab no longer eats an extra 409 (and a silent rebase + retry) for a save that changed nothing, and a pagehide beacon POSTing an unchanged state no longer churns the counter; a skipped save leaves the seq untouched, so the next full save with the same seq is still current. A real change still bumps exactly once. Exception: an adopted save (client seq ahead after seq.json loss) always writes + bumps, so the L6 adopt contract (client+1) is preserved — the no-op skip must not silently move the adopt landing to client. (3) L8 — a second custom-box delete returns 200 again (idempotent): the `bid in deleted` check now runs before the existence check in box_api_delete — the L-DATA1 fix had removed the custom_boxes row, so the second delete fell to 404; a never-existing id still 404s. (4) L9 — box_api_delete now purges the box's state rows server-side (same key set as the client's purgeBoxState: done/tests/edits/actualMinutes/tests_total/usefulMinutes/timerSessions/testLog/assignments, plus topicLinks/boxBookLinks/usefulPrompt). This is a DIRECT stored-state write, so the five merged keys really go. The UI path's purge stays as documented: applyBoxDeletion + a full saveState resurrects the five merged keys through the server's per-box deep merge (known limitation — «بی‌اثر — باکس حذف شده است»); only non-merged keys are really purged by a full save. That limitation is about the UI path, not this handler. (5) L10 — unknown dropped keys are returned in the response as "warnings": [...] (DELIBERATE design decision, warnings variant, not 400s) — a client typo ("delete" for "deleted", "box_id" for "id") used to look successful (200 {"ok": true}) while doing nothing. The success response stays {"ok": true}; warnings are additive only, and only on the 200 path (a 409 refuses the whole body, so nothing was dropped). A wrong-typed KNOWN key still 400s. (6) L15 — lastSaveOk now starts false, not true: "no save ever attempted" is never read as success (a saveState() returning early because stateLoaded is false used to leave the initial true standing). The queued task still sets it on every path, including the byte-identical skip, which counts as success; refreshDataFromServer ignores the return value, as before. Nothing deferred. i18n 1439/1439 (no new keys).
